competency_fulfillment.rationale: Competency: "Solve problems using data presented in a single bar graph (horizontal and vertical)." The samples pair a graph-reading MCQ with a separate, decontextualized addition cloze (5220 + 2200 = ___) that never references the bar graph's values or categories.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: This node registers bar_graphs (30 combos) and addition (8 combos); the addition DNA's combos, as rendered here, produce generic arithmetic unconnected to the graph values shown elsewhere in the batch.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Both the graph-reading stem (8 words) and the arithmetic cloze are short and within the 22-word cap, appropriate for G3 Q3, though a true solve-using-data item would need a connecting sentence neither sample provides.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: For a solve-problems-using-data competency, the variant space would ideally compose one item (read the graph, then compute with its values); instead the two DNAs appear to fire independently here.

competency_alignment.rationale: This capstone data competency should build on q3_2's interpretation skill by adding arithmetic on graph-derived numbers, but the disconnect between graph values and addition operands doesn't show that composition.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The addition operands (5220+2200, 8500+225) are large four-digit values that don't correspond to the two-digit bar-graph totals seen elsewhere in this batch (45-70), undercutting the using-this-data framing.
